## BundlerErrors.UnexpectedSignature class

Thrown when a Morpho authorization signature names a forbidden `authorized` account (for example Bundler3 itself), which would grant operator rights to an unintended address.

**Signature:**

```typescript
class UnexpectedSignature extends Error
```
**Extends:** Error

## Example


```ts
import { BundlerErrors } from "@morpho-org/morpho-sdk";

if (error instanceof BundlerErrors.UnexpectedSignature) {
  // Re-sign the authorization targeting GeneralAdapter1.
}
```
